title: 💻 San Jose IT Hiring Now: Multiple $130K-$300K+ Roles
text:
2 days ago San Jose’s tech scene is buzzing with high‑pay, senior‑level roles right now — especially in AI, cloud, and data. If you’ve got solid experience, there’s a lot here worth a serious look.
Oracle Gen AI Manager Employer: Deloitte Location: San Jose, CA (travel up to 50%) Type: Full-time Salary: $134,500 – $265,100
Lead enterprise generative AI architecture on Oracle Cloud (OCI), designing agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI governance for big clients. Great fit if you know Oracle Cloud, LLMs, and want to drive AI strategy at scale. Senior Software Engineering Manager, Simulation Infrastructure Employer: Muon Space Location: San Jose, CA (hybrid, 3 days/week on-site) Type: Full-time Salary: $241,000 – $266,000 + equity + benefits
Run a team that builds high‑performance spacecraft simulations used to design and operate orbital satellites. Ideal for leaders with simulation, physics-based modeling, and strong C++/Python background. Cyber – AI-Enabled Vulnerability Management Manager Employer: EY Location: San Jose, CA (role can sit anywhere in the US; travel up to 50%) Type: Full-time Salary (Bay Area): $181,200 – $302,100
Manage offensive security teams running penetration tests, red/purple teaming, and AI‑enabled vulns workflows. Strong fit if you’ve led pentest/red team programs and hold advanced certs like OSCP/GPEN/CISSP. Senior Business Analyst Employer: Technology Credit Union (Tech CU) Location: San Jose, CA Type: Full-time
Help business units like Mortgage, Retail, and Marketing turn complex problems into clear requirements and better member experiences. Great for a senior BA who loves workshops, process mapping, and partnering with both business and tech. Staff Data Center Solutions Architect (29112) Employer: Supermicro Location: San Jose, CA Type: Full-time Salary: $155,000 – $180,000
Design large‑scale data center solutions, from power and cooling to compute, storage, and networking. Mix of deep technical architecture and customer-facing pre‑sales/POC work. Cyber Oracle Cloud Security – Manager / Engineering Manager II Employer: Deloitte Location: San Jose, CA (travel up to 50%) Type: Full-time Salary: $134,500 – $265,100
Lead Oracle Cloud ERP/HCM/SCM security programs, design roles and SoD controls, and implement Oracle Risk Management Cloud. Good fit if you’ve led multiple Oracle Cloud security implementations. Senior Applied ML Engineer, Search & Relevance Employer: Adobe Location: San Jose, CA Type: Full-time Salary (CA range): $238,700 – $345,650
Own search, ranking, and recommendations for Adobe Fonts end‑to‑end. Perfect if you’re a strong software engineer with hands‑on experience in embeddings, vector search, and learning‑to‑rank. Workday Financials Manager Employer: Deloitte Location: San Jose, CA (travel up to 50%) Type: Full-time Salary: $144,600 – $265,100
Lead large, full‑lifecycle Workday Financials implementations and finance transformations. Best for folks with multiple Workday Financials go‑lives and strong client‑facing consulting chops. Workday Adaptive Planning Sr Consultant Employer: Deloitte Location: San Jose, CA (travel up to 50%) Type: Full-time Salary: $116,000 – $229,100
Run EPM/Workday Adaptive Planning workstreams for large enterprises, from design to testing and training. Great if you’ve led at least two Adaptive (or similar EPM) deployments. AI Research Scientist (ML / DL / NLP / LLM) Employer: Enigma Location: Hybrid – San Jose, CA Type: Full-time
Research and ship advanced ML/LLM solutions, from PEFT/LoRA and fine‑tuning to RLHF and robust evaluation. A match for PhD‑level (or equivalent) researchers with strong PyTorch and publication‑level work. Forecasting and Workforce Management Data Analyst Employer: TikTok USDS Joint Venture Location: San Jose, CA (in‑person, up to 5 days/week) Type: Full-time Salary: $88,000 – $151,112
Own long‑term FTE forecasting and capacity planning for 2,400+ BPO agents, plus invoice and performance analytics. Strong Excel/SQL and love for dashboards and deep‑dive ops analysis are key. Staff Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering Employer: Google Location: San Jose, CA Type: Full-time Salary: $207,000 – $300,000 + ~20% bonus + equity + benefits
SRE role owning large, distributed systems: design, capacity, automation, and incident response. Great for seasoned engineers who’ve led projects and love building reliable infra at huge scale.
